title: Modern Miami Home with 3 Bedrooms & 3 Baths
description: Beautiful Two-Story Home in Country Walk! Welcome to this charming two-story, 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home with a 2-car garage in the beautiful and desirable Country Walk community in Kendall! This home offers a comfortable layout with plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining. The home features high ceilings, impact windows, a freshly painted exterior, and a spacious family room.
